quizTitle: Suggest, Recommend, Promise, Offer — Tourism and Travel

questions.question: The mayor ___ that visitors explore smaller villages instead of the crowded city center.
The travel blogger ___ a few eco-friendly hotels near the national park.
The local guide ___ to show us around for free if we bought tickets to the museum.
The government ___ to reduce the number of tourist buses entering the old town.
Our teacher ___ that we visit fewer places but spend more time in each city.
The hotel staff ___ several restaurants that use only local ingredients.
The tour operator ___ to refund everyone if the trip had to be cancelled.
The local community ___ free walking tours to encourage responsible travel.
